ClearLedger AssistantBookkeeping service assistant
Hi! I'm the ClearLedger assistant. Tell me what kind of bookkeeping help you need, even if you're not sure which package fits.
For example: “I have about 120 transactions a month and use QuickBooks. I need reconciliation and monthly reports.”
Don't enter passwords, bank login details, card numbers or confidential financial records into this chat. The assistant is for service conversations and onboarding questions.

How the assistant works

1. UnderstandIt asks what software you use, your approximate monthly transactions and the work you want done.
2. RecommendIt explains the published package that matches your stated needs.
3. ConfirmIf you agree with the published price and scope, it directs you to contact Deepak.
4. Custom requestIf you want a lower price or unusual scope, it prepares a request for Deepak's approval instead of promising a discount.
Deepak stays in control.
The assistant cannot approve a discount or make a commitment outside the published rules. It will ask you to wait for Deepak's approval and then contact him directly.

Your financial information stays private.

Bookkeeping requires access to sensitive business information. Our approach is simple: use only the information needed to perform the agreed work, protect access, and never use client information for our own purposes.

Our privacy commitments

  • ✓
    We don't sell your data.
    Your financial records and business information are not sold or used for advertising.
  • ✓
    Only access what is needed.
    We request access based on the bookkeeping task you purchase rather than asking for unnecessary information.
  • ✓
    Your accounts remain yours.
    Whenever possible, clients should provide the appropriate user access instead of sharing passwords.
  • ✓
    No unauthorized use.
    Client records are used only to provide the agreed bookkeeping or data-entry service.
  • ✓
    Clear communication.
    If we need additional information or access, we explain what is needed and why.

Important: No online service can honestly promise that data is impossible to lose, steal, or breach. Our goal is to minimize access, avoid unnecessary copies, and handle client information responsibly.

Why clients can feel comfortable working with us

Transparent pricingNo hidden consultation or surprise subscription fees.

Direct communicationTalk directly with the person handling your bookkeeping.
